title.zh: Hugging Face 传输工具的工作文件

explain.en: Working folder of hf_xet, Hugging Face's file transfer tool. Current versions keep only upload indexes and resume data here; most of the space is usually a download cache left by older versions. Downloaded models (in the hub folder) are not affected; an unfinished upload would start over. The official docs describe deleting this folder to free space.
explain.zh: Hugging Face 传文件工具（hf_xet）的工作文件夹。现在的版本只在这里放上传用的索引和断点续传记录，占地方的多半是旧版本留下的下载缓存。删掉不会丢已经下载的模型（模型在 hub 文件夹里），只是没传完的上传要从头再来。官方文档写了可以整个删掉来腾空间。

evidence.note: Present on the maintainer's Mac: 8.3G, all in chunk-cache, files last written 2026-01-05. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: Kept at review, not safe: no maintainer statement confirms every hf_xet version ignores an old chunk-cache.
